name: Medusa VN
source:
This is a kinetic novel intended as a prequel to the short action game "[url=https://princesschoochoo.itch.io/ld46medusa]Medusa[/url]" made by the same developer.

In this story it is explained how the pilot Lilith met the tentacle monster Medusa.

[Edited from [url=https://princesschoochoo.itch.io/medusa-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作是一部无分支视觉小说，是同一开发者制作的短篇动作游戏《[url=https://princesschoochoo.itch.io/ld46medusa]Medusa[/url]》的前传。

故事讲述飞行员莉莉丝如何与触手怪物美杜莎相遇。

[编译自[url=https://princesschoochoo.itch.io/medusa-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
